answer: The cheapest sybil defence is a cost the attacker cannot bulk-buy. Customs broker licence with port authority attestation sets that cost as a broker licence number that checks out in the port authority register. The yarrow of the idea is the waiting: the credential accrues slowly, month by month, and no payment speeds it up. A farm minting a hundred identities faces a hundred waits, and the opal in every wait is a human showing up in person, again and again. The echo that finishes it is the verifier, who reads the dates and trusts the arithmetic.
